description: This file defines the SampleGridPagerAdapter class, which extends FragmentGridPagerAdapter to provide fragment pages and backgrounds for a grid-based pager interface in an Android Wear app. It manages rows of fragments, loads background images asynchronously, and handles background transitions for each row and page.

classes.name: SampleGridPagerAdapter
classes.description: An adapter providing fragments and backgrounds for a grid pager, supporting multiple rows of content and dynamic background transitions on an Android Wear device.

methods.name: SampleGridPagerAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing rows of fragments and background drawables.

methods.name: getFragment
methods.description: Returns the fragment at the specified row and column.

methods.name: getBackgroundForRow
methods.description: Returns the background drawable for a specified row, with asynchronous loading.

methods.name: getBackgroundForPage
methods.description: Returns the background drawable for a specific page identified by row and column, with asynchronous loading.

methods.name: getRowCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of rows.

methods.name: getColumnCount
methods.description: Returns the number of columns in a specified row.

methods.name: DrawableLoadingTask
methods.description: AsyncTask to load drawable resources in background and update backgrounds with transition effects.
